title: Triple-check confluence EA: SMA250 distance-filter + reversal candlestick + Stochastic OB/OS with rate-limited grid-add (fxDreema ex.55/56)
entry_long: price above SMA250 AND distance(price,SMA250) < 80 pips AND 3-bar reversal pattern (ID3=bear,ID2=bull,ID1=bull) AND Stochastic crossing up through oversold level 30

exit: winning side: trailing stop 20 pips / step 1 pip (Flow-Trend mode); losing side: switches to Reverse-Trend grid-add mode (no trailing) re-entering same direction every ~15-30 pips (gridDistance / gridDistance*2 formula) with lot +0.05 per add, rate-limited to max 1 add per bar; no stated SL on initial or added orders

Video also briefly covers ex.55 (3-bar impulse/imbalance breakout with trap lines and stop-loss sized off historical consecutive-loss count) and ex.87/108 (breakout variants, one had zero trades on gold = broken) - not detailed here, worth a separate pass if pursued

title: Example-97 pending-order straddle scalper with volatility-of-volatility ATR filter and capped martingale (RV1->RV2->RV3 evolution)
timeframe: unspecified (on-tick logic, no fixed signal TF stated)
entry_long: place pending buy-stop ~75 pips above current price (once per bar); only armed when ATR-based volatility-of-volatility filter confirms rising volatility (RV2+); when price hits it, opens buy and cancels the opposite pending sell
entry_short: mirror: pending sell-stop ~75 pips below current price, same once-per-bar + volatility filter gate; cancels opposite pending buy when triggered
exit: TP ~60 pips (bound by broker min stop-level, e.g. GX Gold/Standard=60); has SL (exact pip distance not stated, referenced via 'stop loss'/'L Plus' var); RV3 detects a losing close via check-profit-of-last-trade instead of native SL flag (RV1 bug: slippage sometimes closed just short of the SL price so 'closed-by-SL' event never fired, breaking the martingale trigger)
escalation_cap: no fixed lot cap stated; capped via consecutive-loss kill-switch (example shown: stop trading after 10 consecutive losses) - multiplier (LotX, default x2, adjustable e.g. 1.2/1.5) itself uncapped in lot size
buildon_idea: swap the x2 doubling multiplier to a smaller linear-add or log-lot law instead of geometric martingale to reduce fat-tail risk while keeping the ATR volatility-of-volatility entry filter and consecutive-loss kill-switch; also needs per-broker matching of min-lot/min-stop-level (min TP/SL distance) before reuse across brokers
novelty_note: straddle pending-buy+pending-sell (non-hedging, cancel-opposite-on-fill) is a common breakout pattern; the double-ATR 'volatility of volatility' filter to gate entries during choppy/flat periods, plus explicit fix for a slippage-caused SL-detection bug, are the more distinctive parts; medium novelty overall

title: WPR(14) overbought/oversold cross + EMA200 trend filter with price-distance sanity filter and grid recovery (Example 70)
entry_long: WPR(14) crosses above -80 AND close of prior candle > EMA200 AND absolute distance between current price and EMA200 < 40 pips (avoid buying too far/expensive from the MA)
entry_short: mirror: WPR(14) crosses below -20 AND close of prior candle < EMA200 AND absolute distance to EMA200 < 40 pips
exit: no SL, no TP; optional trailing stop (configurable to start only after a chosen profit); grid recovery orders every 15 pips using linear-add lot increment (+0.05 lot per grid step, constant named L Plus 0.05); separate favorable-direction add-on mode (snowball) also adds lots every 15 pips while price moves in profit; close via aggregated profit target (exact $ value not stated in excerpt)
escalation_cap: none
buildon_idea: add a hard cap on number of grid adds (e.g. max 5-8 steps) or max lot, or switch the linear +0.05/step to a log-scale lot law; flat-lot test first (disable grid/snowball adds) to confirm the WPR+EMA200 entry itself has edge before layering recovery grid; test the 40-pip distance filter across other symbols/TFs since author only tuned account size (not the entry logic) to pass his own DD<30% criterion
novelty_note: WPR is used instead of RSI for a faster overbought/oversold signal; the distance-from-EMA200 filter (skip entries that are 'too far/expensive' from the MA) is a reusable risk-reduction idea not commonly taught; author explicitly demonstrates that his DD reduction came from raising account size, not from any parameter edge - medium novelty due to the distance filter

title: Course EP4 multi-example: EX26 dual-group rebalance/lot-spinning martingale, EX9 Fair Value Gap breakout re-entry, EX10 MACD-divergence martingale
entry_long: EX26: on start, opens Buy in group-1 regardless of market direction while group-2 opens Sell at the same point (deliberate two-sided 'rebalance'); each group then adds same-direction orders every 30 pips as price continues (martingale-style lot-spinning), the two groups converge as price commits to a direction. EX9 (FVG): after a 3-candle bullish Fair Value Gap forms (ID1 low > ID3 high, gap = ID2 body, min body size 20 pips), buy once price closes back inside the gap (once-per-bar). EX10: buy on MACD bullish divergence (classic or hidden, mutually exclusive toggle switches).
entry_short: EX26: group-1 opens Sell instead if price falls right after the first order (and group-2 mirrors with Buy); same 30-pip grid-add logic applies to the Sell side. EX9: mirror - sell when price closes back inside a bearish 3-candle FVG. EX10: sell on MACD bearish divergence.
exit: EX26: no SL, no TP; closes both groups together once combined floating profit across group-1+group-2 (Buy+Sell) exceeds $3 - deliberately tiny target to spin lot volume; author warns brokers may flag/limit this and recommends withdrawing profit daily rather than letting the account run. EX9: no SL, no TP, fixed 0.01 lot, closes per-trade once profit exceeds 15 pips (sum), one order per gap event, deletes the drawn gap lines on entry/exit. EX10: no SL, no TP; combined Buy+Sell profit in the group closes at >$10; uses FXDreema's built-in betting-martingale money-management block (lot starts 0.01, x2 multiplier on loss).
escalation_cap: none
family: grid-martingale-lot-spinning (EX26); candlestick-FVG-breakout (EX9, fixed lot, not martingale); macd-divergence-martingale (EX10)
buildon_idea: EX26/EX10: add an explicit max-order-count or max-lot cap before any live use - EX26 grew to 1600+ orders over ~5 months with no technical cap (author's only mitigation is manual daily profit withdrawal, not a coded limit); run a flat-lot (no multiply) version of EX10's MACD-divergence entry to check for real edge before re-adding the martingale multiplier. EX9 is the safer build-on candidate since it already uses fixed 0.01 lot (no escalation) - extend it with a defined SL/TP instead of relying purely on the quick gap-fill profit target, and test across more symbols since author only ran ~2 years on one instrument.
novelty_note: EX26's simultaneous two-sided 'rebalance' opening (both Buy and Sell groups from the same start point, each escalating independently) is a distinctive lot-farming technique the author states he uses specifically to generate trading volume/rebates rather than as a standalone edge - he flags real broker-abuse risk himself. EX9 (Fair Value Gap) is a well-known ICT retail concept, implemented here cleanly with fixed lot sizing - low novelty but low risk. EX10 (MACD divergence + betting-martingale) is a common combination - low novelty, high martingale risk.

title: Dynamic GD Zone grid + hedge (scouting example 127)
indicators: zigzag(12, optional trend filter for buy/sell mode)
entry_long: buy allowed only while price stays inside dynamic zone (below Upper LINE, above Lower LINE); opens a new buy every GD Distance=100 pips move; can be disabled via Buy Mode toggle for trend-safety play
entry_short: mirror: sell allowed only inside zone (below Upper LINE, above Lower LINE); opens a new sell every 100 pips move; toggle via Sell Mode
exit: each grid order TP=100 pips, no per-order SL; whole basket also closes (bulk close) once floating profit reaches Close Money=5 USD, rebuilding a fresh zone; separately if price breaks out of the zone and floating loss reaches Money Loss=10% of Balance, a single hedge order fires (or alternative Cut Loss Mode, mutually exclusive with hedge)
escalation_cap: hedge = single order sized at 2x total lots on the losing side, fires once per breakout (not repeated/uncapped); base grid lot fixed 0.01
buildon_idea: already single-shot capped hedge (2x basket lot, triggered at 10% balance loss) not uncapped martingale; flat-lot test first (disable hedge, measure grid-only PF); try swapping hedge trigger % (5% vs 10%) or lot law to linear-add across the 20-order (±1000 pip) zone cap already built in (max ~20 buy + 20 sell orders per zone width)
novelty_note: breakout-triggered dynamic price channel that regenerates itself after each bulk-close or breakout event, combined with a single (not repeating) hedge order sized off basket lots — more structured than plain martingale; narrator frames it explicitly as a scouting/commission-farming EA, tested on XAUUSD standard spread ~16

title: Bollinger Band mean-reversion entry + engulfing filter, distance-based auto lot-doubling grid add-on
entry_long: candle ID1 & ID2 low both below BB lower band (bullish reversal candles, min body 5 pip) -> buy 0.1 fixed lot, no SL/TP; subsequent adds when price keeps falling: if gap from last buy >=50 pip use lot x2 (needs bullish reversal candle re-crossing BB lower band), else re-add at fixed 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: candle ID1 & ID2 high both above BB upper band -> sell 0.1 fixed lot; adds mirror the buy-side grid/lot-doubling logic
exit: close all buy+sell when combined profit > 10 pip (single position) or > 5 pip (2+ positions), no fixed SL/TP
escalation_cap: none stated (lot doubles via formula lot_BS*2 on adds spaced >=50 pip; no max order count or lot ceiling mentioned)
buildon_idea: add no_sl -> hard SL and a max-orders cap on the grid; distance-gated lot-doubling (only escalate lot if the adverse move exceeds 50 pip) is a more disciplined grid variant than plain martingale - worth extracting as reusable pattern; 2yr backtest showed 43.19% profit/17.52% DD @$10000, 725 trades - re-test with SL added since current no-SL exposure is unbounded on gap risk
novelty_note: BB band-touch reversal entry + a spacing-gated lot-escalation rule (not pure time/loss-triggered martingale) is a somewhat novel grid variant

title: Equity-drawdown-controlled EMA12/20 crossover: fixed lot normally, escalating lot when equity drops below a rolling 5%-of-equity floor
entry_long: EMA12 crosses above EMA20 (candle ID2) and EMA12 stays above EMA20 by >3 pip distance (candle ID0), exponential; first order = 0.1 fixed lot, no SL/TP
entry_short: mirror: EMA12 crosses below EMA20 by >3 pip distance
exit: close all buy+sell when combined profit > $30; also an equity-floor recompute (equity - 5% of equity) after every order
escalation_cap: none stated (lot doubles via lot_BS*2 each additional order placed only while equity stays below the rolling floor; resets to 0 after the $30 profit close)
buildon_idea: add hard SL and an explicit max-order cap; the equity-floor trigger (only escalate lot once equity has already dropped 5% from last-recorded high) is a distinctive drawdown-gated martingale variant worth extracting - it only doubles lot after confirmed adverse equity movement, not blindly on every loss; 2yr backtest showed 12.9% max DD @$10000, 81 trades - relatively tame result worth re-verifying flat-lot
novelty_note: equity-percentage floor as the martingale trigger (instead of simple consecutive-loss counting) is a notable risk-aware twist on martingale; medium-high novelty

title: 6-candle reversal pattern (3 candles one direction + 3 opposite) fixed-lot entry, no SL/TP, pip-target close

title: Spinning-top candlestick reversal (long wicks both sides, small body) entry with martingale x2 and fixed SL/TP
entry_long: ID1 bullish with both upper & lower wick > body size, ID2 & ID3 bearish (min body 4 pip) -> buy at ID0 open, martingale lot (init 0.1, x2 on loss)
entry_short: mirror: ID1 bearish with both wicks > body size, ID2 & ID3 bullish -> sell at ID0 open, martingale lot
exit: SL 15 pip, TP 20 pip fixed

title: Combined reversal(EX005-style 6-candle) + spinning-top(EX006-style) entries in parallel groups, martingale lot, pooled profit-target close, optional equity%% cut-loss switch
entry_long: group1 (spinning-top): ID1 bullish w/ both wicks>body, ID2&ID3 bearish min body 4pip; group2 (reversal): ID1,ID2,ID3 bullish min body 2pip + ID4,ID5,ID6 bearish min body 2pip -> buy martingale lot (init 0.1, x2 on loss), no SL/TP, tagged by group 1 or 2
entry_short: mirror conditions for both groups -> sell martingale lot, no SL/TP
exit: close all (both groups) when pooled profit > $100; optional Cut_loss_Mode switch (default off) closes all if pooled loss < -30% of balance
escalation_cap: none stated on the martingale ladder itself; only account-level circuit breaker is the optional -30%-of-balance cut-loss (off by default)
buildon_idea: turn the optional Cut_loss_Mode ON by default and add per-order SL, not just an account-level -30% breaker; combining two independent pattern families (spinning-top + 6-candle reversal) into shared risk pooling is itself the buildable idea - it increased 2yr profit to 90.76% while cutting max DD to 27.19% (vs EX005/EX006 standalone, which blew up in the 2023-alone test) - worth extracting as a portfolio-pooling pattern even before fixing the martingale/no-SL issues
novelty_note: multi-signal pooling with shared profit-target and shared optional equity-based circuit breaker is a notable structural idea (diversification-via-pooling), even though each individual signal is low-novelty

title: Stochastic(5) OB/OS scalper with balance-scaled auto-lot toggle
entry_long: Stochastic(5) within 1-30 (oversold) -> buy, once per bar; lot = fixed 0.1, or auto_lot=Balance/100000 if auto-lot mode enabled
entry_short: Stochastic(5) within 70-100 (overbought) -> sell, once per bar; same fixed/auto-lot choice
exit: close side when floating profit(sum of pip)>30pip; no SL/TP
escalation_cap: n/a (single entry per side until closed; no grid/martingale)
buildon_idea: no grid/martingale here so build-on = add SL, and stress-test the auto-lot (Balance/100000) scaling since author's own test showed profit 65%->93% but DD 29%->40% when enabling it; verify Stochastic OB/OS edge flat-lot across symbols first
novelty_note: simple Stochastic OB/OS mean-reversion entry; the auto-lot-from-balance formula (Balance/100000) is the more reusable/novel piece

title: ADX(30) cross triggers simultaneous 5-level buy+sell pending-order grid
entry_long: ADX base line (on close price) crosses above level 30 -> place 5 buy pending orders simultaneously in a grid (grid size -30pip offset, 100% even spacing/volume), once per bar
entry_short: same ADX(30) cross event -> place 5 sell pending orders simultaneously in a mirrored grid
exit: delete remaining pending orders + close all open positions (both sides) when combined floating profit(money)>$100, then restart
escalation_cap: 5 pending levels (Max_Order_Grid=5), fixed 0.1 lot each level
buildon_idea: already capped at 5 levels; add SL/TP using the block's built-in %-of-first-order scaling fields; try setting the Volume-size-next-order gradation to 150-200% for a controlled (capped-step) martingale grid instead of fixed
novelty_note: demonstrates fxDreema's buy/sell-pending-order-in-grid block with %-based gradation for spacing/volume/SL/TP scaling in one shot - the block itself is the reusable building block; author reports ~30%/1yr test

title: ICT Price Action pending-order EA: bear/bull-candle-midpoint entry, SL/TP 1:2
entry_long: bearish candle(ID1) with body>=30pip -> place buy pending order at midpoint of that candle (close price offset by half its body size); SL=candle close price; TP=200% of SL distance; pending expires after 5 bars unfilled
entry_short: bullish candle(ID1) with body>=30pip -> mirrored sell pending order at midpoint; SL=candle close, TP=200% of SL; 5-bar pending expiry
exit: TP/SL as set per trade; unfilled pending order auto-deleted after C_candle_Limit=5 bars
escalation_cap: n/a (single pending order per side, no grid/martingale)
buildon_idea: already flat-lot with SL/TP; extend across symbol/TF and test scaling lot with balance; author reports low DD (8-25%) at lot 0.1-0.3 over 2yr, 100%+ profit at lot 0.4/25%DD
novelty_note: candle-midpoint pending-order entry off a large-body candle with a 5-bar pending expiry is a distinct low-DD variant among this batch's mostly no-SL grid EAs

title: ICT Price Action V2: distance-filtered breakout-line entry + martingale correction, SL20/TP30pip
entry_long: ID1 and ID4 both bearish candles, close(ID1)<open(ID4), distance(open(ID4) to close(ID1))>60pip -> draw buy_point line at open(ID1); when price crosses up through buy_point -> buy martingale (start 0.1, x2), SL=20pip/TP=30pip, once per bar
entry_short: mirror: ID1 & ID4 both bullish, close(ID1)>open(ID4), distance>60pip -> sell_point line at open(ID1); cross down -> sell martingale, SL20/TP30pip
exit: fixed-pip SL20/TP30 per trade; no separate account-level close block shown
escalation_cap: none stated on multiplier steps
buildon_idea: add an explicit cap on martingale steps or switch to linear-add since each trade already carries SL/TP; author reports low DD (8.3-24.8%) across lot 0.1-0.4 over 1yr, worth extending symbol/TF before deciding on the martingale law
novelty_note: distance-filtered 2-candle setup that draws a breakout line and trades the cross, combined with per-trade fixed-pip SL/TP martingale - distinct from the mostly no-SL grid EAs elsewhere in this batch

title: RSI(7)+doji grid EA with first/last-order profit-pairing close (original)
entry_long: RSI(7)<30 (oversold) and bullish doji on ID1 (lower wick>upper wick, small body) -> buy 0.01 lot, no SL/TP, once per bar
entry_short: RSI(7)>70 (overbought) and bearish doji on ID1 -> sell 0.01 lot, no SL/TP, once per bar
exit: correction adds (linear +0.01 lot) spaced >=100pip apart on bullish/bearish engulfing reversal signal, capped Max_Order=30 and lot upper-limit=0.2; with <3 open trades close outright at profit>$5; with >=3 trades, close only the FIRST and LAST order once their combined profit>$5, repeat
escalation_cap: Max Order=30; lot upper limit=0.2
buildon_idea: already capped (30 orders, 0.2 lot ceiling); the standout reusable idea is closing only the first+last order to pair a loser with a winner instead of closing the whole basket - worth extracting into EDGE_CATALOG regardless of this EA's overall verdict; flat-lot test to isolate the RSI+doji entry edge
novelty_note: first+last-order pairing close is the notable novel mechanism here, reusable across other grid/martingale EAs to trim losers without closing everything

title: RSI(7)+doji grid EA, revise 1: adds buy/sell trend-mode switches
timeframe: M5 (also tested M1 in same session)
entry_long: mode_buy switch=on, RSI(7)<30 and bullish doji on ID1 -> buy 0.01 lot, no SL/TP, once per bar
entry_short: mode_sell switch=on, RSI(7)>70 and bearish doji on ID1 -> sell 0.01 lot, no SL/TP, once per bar
exit: same first/last-order close at combined profit>$5 once 3+ trades open; 1-2 trades close outright at profit>$5; correction adds linear +0.01 lot spaced >=100pip on engulfing reversal
escalation_cap: unspecified in this revise (Max Order/lot-ceiling constants not shown on screen, unlike the original version)
buildon_idea: re-add the original's explicit Max Order + lot ceiling before any live use; author reports 5yr gold M5 backtest DD<30%/~70%profit-per-year, and M1 with same settings gave 500%+/5yr on 10,000+ trades - promising enough to verify and extend symbol/TF
novelty_note: adds an explicit buy-only/sell-only trend-direction toggle on top of the original - a practical operational refinement rather than a new signal

title: ICT 3-candle zone + engulfing entry, revise 1: fixed-lot grid correction, pip-scaled TP
entry_long: 3 consecutive bearish candles(ID1-3) with combined body>=50pip draw ICT_Zone_B1/B2; price closes inside zone + bullish engulfing (close crosses above open(ID1)) -> buy 0.1 lot, once per bar
entry_short: 3 consecutive bullish candles with combined body>=50pip draw ICT_Zone_s1/s2; bearish engulfing -> sell 0.1 lot, once per bar
exit: TP=10pip scaled by position size (pip-as-position); grid correction adds fixed 0.1 lot spaced 10pip apart triggered by a 2-candle bear/bull-candle reversal signal; close-all both sides when combined floating profit(pip)>TP
escalation_cap: unspecified (no explicit max-order cap shown)
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-order cap on the grid correction before build-on; author reports 5yr EURUSD H1 backtest: 120% profit/32% DD at TP20/grid10pip, and 20.8% DD at TP10/grid15pip/lot0.15 - promising enough to extend symbol/TF and add a hard cap
novelty_note: 3-candle cumulative-body zone (ICT Zone) built from a combined-body-size filter across 3 bars is a distinctive variant of the FVG/gap concept used elsewhere in this batch

title: EMA(10/200) trend-cross entry with 3-case reversal-timing grid correction and $ cut-loss
entry_long: EMA10>EMA200 (uptrend) and close(ID1) crosses above EMA10 with bullish body>5pip -> buy 0.01 lot fixed, once per bar
entry_short: EMA10<EMA200 (downtrend) and close(ID1) crosses below EMA10 with bearish body>5pip -> sell 0.01 lot fixed
exit: close all when combined floating profit(money)>$30; cut-loss closes+terminates EA at -$3000; correction adds (linear +0.01 lot) spaced 20pip apart, triggered by 3 distinct cases (grid-distance-met+reversal, grid-distance-met-only, or engulfing-only-before-grid-distance-met), capped Max_Order=15 and lot upper-limit=0.2
escalation_cap: Max Order=15; lot upper limit=0.2; account cut-loss=$3000
buildon_idea: already capped (15 orders, 0.2 lot ceiling, $3000 cut-loss); the 3-case correction decision tree is worth extracting into EDGE_CATALOG as a reusable pattern regardless of this EA's own verdict; originally tuned for EURUSD (20pip grid) but tested here on gold due to missing EURUSD history - re-test on EURUSD once data available
novelty_note: 3-scenario correction logic (full-grid-distance+reversal vs full-grid-distance-only vs early-engulfing-override) is more nuanced than the single-condition martingale/grid adds seen in most other cards this batch

title: EMA(10/100) trend-cross entry, revise 1: true doubling-martingale correction
entry_long: EMA10>EMA100 and close(ID1) crosses above EMA10, bullish body(ID1)>=5pip -> buy 0.1 lot fixed, once per bar
entry_short: EMA10<EMA100 and close(ID1) crosses below EMA10, bearish body(ID1)>=5pip -> sell 0.1 lot fixed
exit: close all when combined floating profit(money)>$30; correction adds via true martingale (lot*=2 each add) spaced >=20pip apart on bullish/bearish engulfing reversal signal, capped Max_Order=30
escalation_cap: Max Order=30 trades (no lot-size ceiling stated in this revise, unlike the sibling linear-add version)
buildon_idea: order-count is capped at 30 but the lot itself doubles unbounded - add an explicit lot ceiling (like the original's 0.2 upper-limit) before build-on; author reports 5yr EURUSD H1 backtest: 264.7% profit, 27.9% DD, 2533 trades, DD stable across the run - promising enough to extend symbol/TF once capped
novelty_note: same EMA-cross entry as the linear-add sibling card but swaps the correction lot-law for doubling martingale, directly illustrating the author's own iteration/tradeoff between linear-add and martingale for the same base strategy

title: Martingale 3-EMA reversal-add + dynamic trailing stop
entry_long: EMA3>EMA200 (trend zone) and EMA3>EMA8 (alignment), once per bar, min lot 0.01
entry_short: mirror: EMA3<EMA200 and EMA3<EMA8
exit: group trailing stop 200pip/step10pip activated only once position exists; dynamic profit-to-arm-trail step = $5 x order_count (5,10,15...45); hard cut-loss at -$3000 (30% of $10000) closes all + terminates EA
escalation_cap: 9 steps, lotX=2, capped at 3.0 lots (actual max 2.56)
buildon_idea: already capped at 9 steps/3 lots with account-level cut-loss; try linear-add or log lot law instead of x2 to reduce tail risk while keeping the EMA-reversal re-entry trigger; also test smaller trailing-stop distance to lock profit sooner
novelty_note: martingale add gated by EMA fast/slow reversal signal (not fixed price step) plus escalating profit target before trailing activates; somewhat novel add-timing mechanism

title: Chart button close-by/close-sell/delete-object tutorial (grid EMA200 entry)
entry_long: candle close ID0 above EMA200, grid spacing >=10 pips between own orders
entry_short: candle close ID0 below EMA200, grid spacing >=10 pips between own orders
exit: manual via on-chart buttons (close buy / close sell / delete objects); no SL/TP, no automatic profit close
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed lot)
buildon_idea: tooling video (chart button + object drawing tutorial); underlying entry is a bare unbounded EMA200 grid with manual close - if reused, add automatic profit-target close and a max-order cap before any real use
novelty_note: admin/tooling content - button drawing and object management technique, not a strategy demo

title: Fibonacci retracement 7-level grid entries on EMA5/12/200 cross
entry_long: EMA5>EMA200 and EMA5 cross above EMA12 draws buy-fib (90-candle lookback low/high); price crossing up through any of 7 fib levels (0/23.6/38.2/50/61.8/78.6/100) opens a buy in that level's group, SL15 TP30
entry_short: mirror: EMA5<EMA200 and EMA5 cross below EMA12 draws sell-fib; price crossing down through any fib level opens sell in that level's group, SL15 TP30
exit: fixed SL 15 pips / TP 30 pips per order; fib line + variables reset (deleted/zeroed) when EMA5 crosses back through EMA200
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 0.1 lot per level, up to 7 simultaneous group entries)
buildon_idea: author states EA is incomplete (needs more entry/exit refinement); explicit build-on candidate — add filters per level, vary SL/TP by fib level, or combine only the 61.8 level (as done in the revise video) for cleaner signal
novelty_note: auto-drawn Fibonacci retracement gated by EMA trend+cross, multi-level grouped entries; fib-as-entry-grid is a distinctive mechanism vs plain EMA

title: Fibonacci 61.8 level + candle-pattern confirm, fixed-lot grid rescue on drawdown
entry_long: price below EMA100 with EMA3 cross-down EMA8 draws sell-fib (auto); reverse case (price above EMA100, EMA3 cross-up EMA8) draws buy-fib; candle ID0 crosses up fib level 61.8 (only this level used) plus 2-candle reversal pattern (down-candle then up-candle) triggers buy 0.01 lot, no SL/TP
entry_short: mirror: candle crosses down fib 61.8 plus reversal pattern (up-candle then down-candle) triggers sell 0.01 lot, no SL/TP
exit: grid rescue: if losing, add same-direction order every 100 pips at fixed 0.01 lot (no size escalation); close all when combined profit > $3; loose cut-loss disabled in practice (max order constant set to 100, i.e. effectively off)
escalation_cap: none (fixed 0.01 lot per add, soft cap at 100 orders which author calls 'not really using cut-loss')
buildon_idea: revise-1 already shows strong backtest (2024 XAUUSD M1, 2111 orders, +186%, DD 25%); build-on: add a real order cap (author admits 100-order cap is effectively disabled) and test other fib levels/patterns as author suggests (e.g. doji check)
novelty_note: refines EX023 base video by narrowing to single 61.8 level + 2-candle reversal pattern filter + fixed-lot grid rescue on adverse move; author reports strong single-year backtest — flag as build-on-viable per user doctrine

title: Sideway-channel breakout with single 2x hedge add on reversal
indicators: horizontal channel lines (48-candle high/low, max 100pip width)
entry_long: price closes >50 pips above the upper sideway line (drawn from 48-candle high/low, only valid if channel width <=100 pips)
entry_short: price closes >50 pips below the lower sideway line
exit: close all when combined profit > $50; if first trade moves 50 pips against it, opens one opposite-direction hedge order at 2x the first order's lot size (lot_x=2), then waits for the $50 combined profit target
escalation_cap: unspecified (only a single hedge step shown in transcript; no stated cap on further doubling if the hedge also loses)
buildon_idea: author suggests combining this hedge technique with other EAs; build-on: verify/add an explicit max-step cap on the hedge ladder (transcript shows only 1 hedge add - unclear what happens if that also goes against price) before treating as safe; low order count, good for portfolio diversification per author
novelty_note: channel-breakout entry gated by min channel width, single-hedge-doubling rescue instead of full martingale ladder; tested EURUSD H1 2yr +139% DD56%

title: Scalping rebalance: dual-direction grid + martingale reversal, high order count
entry_long: first order always opens with no condition (buy immediately when flat); subsequent buys add every time price extends >30 pips beyond last buy in favorable direction (grid), or opens buy via martingale mode when price reverses above last sell's open price
entry_short: mirrors buy logic: sell continuation grid every 30 pips, or martingale-mode sell when price reverses below last buy's open price
exit: close all (buy+sell) when combined profit > $3, no SL/TP on any order
escalation_cap: none stated (uses FX DMA built-in 'martingale point' sell mode with no explicit lot cap or max-order cap)
buildon_idea: author explicitly designed this for high-frequency/rebate-farming traders (>3000 orders/year); build-on: add explicit max-order cap and switch built-in martingale mode to linear-add or log lot law before any real capital use — currently no visible risk ceiling
novelty_note: deliberately unbounded high-turnover rebalance EA aimed at trade-count/rebate farming rather than edge; low novelty as a directional edge, notable as a volume-generation pattern

title: Multi-group scaling rebalance: two parallel grid+martingale groups
entry_long: group1 starts with immediate buy, group2 starts with immediate sell (opposite start sides); each group then adds in the direction price moves (continuation grid every 30 pips) or reverses (martingale) exactly as in EX025, run twice in parallel under separate group IDs
entry_short: same as long, mirrored per group
exit: close both groups together when combined profit across group1+group2 > $3; no SL/TP
escalation_cap: none stated (two parallel uncapped martingale/grid groups running simultaneously)
buildon_idea: direct extension of EX025 to double order volume via parallel groups for lot/rebate farming; build-on: cap orders per group and add per-group kill-switch before real use — author notes ~3000 orders/yr and +85% in 1yr Control-Point test but risk ceiling is undefined
novelty_note: multi-group architecture (2 independent state machines sharing one close condition) is the main technical lesson; underlying edge same low-novelty grid/martingale as EX025

title: Grid hedging with two-way profit close and order-count cut-loss
entry_long: first buy opens unconditionally when flat; subsequent buys add every 20 pips as price extends favorably (continuation grid), fixed 0.1 lot each
entry_short: mirror: first sell opens unconditionally when flat; subsequent sells add every 20 pips as price extends favorably, fixed 0.1 lot each
exit: close all buy+sell when combined profit >= $30; hard cut-loss closes everything if buy orders >=10 AND sell orders >=10 (order-count-based cap, not a $ cut-loss)
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 0.1 lot); order-count cap 10 per side triggers forced close
buildon_idea: already has a real cap (10 orders/side forces close regardless of profit) unlike EX025/26; build-on: convert forced-close-at-cap into a proper stop-loss level, or extend cap/spacing per symbol volatility
novelty_note: straightforward simultaneous buy+sell grid with an order-count-based safety net instead of price-based cut-loss; moderate novelty in using order count as the risk brake

title: Grid hedging with grouped multi-order closing (oldest+2 newest)
entry_long: first buy opens unconditionally when flat (mode toggle true); subsequent buys add every 20 pips as price extends against/away from prior buy (continuation grid), fixed 0.1 lot each
entry_short: mirror: first sell opens unconditionally; subsequent sells add every 20 pips, fixed 0.1 lot each
exit: once >=3 orders on a side, close oldest+newest-2 as a group when their combined profit > $20; if <3 orders, close all on that side when unrealized profit > $20; a 'Cut loss=15' constant exists but is not shown wired into an active close block in the transcript
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 0.1 lot); no confirmed enforced max-order cap
buildon_idea: strong 1yr backtest (+145% Control-Point / +145% Every-tick, but DD 63.8% is high); build-on: wire the unused 'Cut loss=15' constant into an actual max-order or $ cut-loss block to tame the 63.8% DD before any further use
novelty_note: partial-basket closing (rotate out oldest 3-order group at a time) is a distinct rebalancing mechanism vs simple close-all; DD is notably high for a no-SL grid

title: Double Parabolic SAR scalping with EMA200 filter and martingale doubling
entry_long: candle ID1 close above EMA200, SAR1(0.02) below candle close, and SAR1 below SAR2(0.03) — gated to fire once per signal via counter-reset logic; add-on buy triggers when price moves against first buy, spaced 80 pips, lot doubled (lotX=2) each add, re-confirmed against same 3 SAR/EMA conditions
entry_short: mirror: candle below EMA200, SAR1 above close, SAR1 above SAR2; add-on sell same 80-pip spacing and lotX=2 doubling
exit: close all when combined profit > 13-pip-equivalent; optional $ cut-loss at -$300 exists but is disabled by default (Cut loss=false)
escalation_cap: none stated — each successive add is 2x the prior add's lot (compounding), with only the once-per-signal counter gating re-entry timing, not lot size or order count
buildon_idea: strong reported backtest (EURUSD H4 1yr, +106%, MaxDD 16%, RelDD 20%) but martingale doubling has no stated step cap and cut-loss ships disabled by default; build-on: cap escalation steps and enable the existing -$300 cut-loss constant before any real use
novelty_note: dual-Parabolic-SAR (different step values) crossover-style filter combined with EMA200 trend gate is a distinctive signal; counter-based once-per-signal gating is a reusable FX-Dreema technique

title: RSI-triggered 6-level pending-order grid capped at 1 signal per day
entry_long: RSI(14, candle ID1) crosses above 30 triggers placement of 6 pending buy orders (3 above, 3 below current price via 15-pip grid spacing), fixed 0.1 lot each, no SL/TP; gated to fire once per day via counter-reset at server time 00:00-00:01, with pending orders deleted at 23:59 each day
entry_short: mirror: RSI crosses below 70 triggers 6 pending sell orders (3 above/3 below, 15-pip grid), fixed 0.1 lot, same once-per-day gating and midnight pending cleanup
exit: close all when combined profit > $20; daily reset also clears counters and any unfilled pending orders
escalation_cap: hard cap: max 1 RSI-triggered grid deployment (6 pending orders) per calendar day via counter+time-filter reset
buildon_idea: already has a clean daily-frequency cap unlike most other examples in this batch; build-on: add a real SL to each pending order and test tighter/wider grid spacing per symbol volatility — reported EURUSD H4 1yr result: +53.1% but MaxDD 50.5%/RelDD 50.5% (high for a fixed-lot grid, worth investigating before reuse)
novelty_note: daily order-count governance (counter + time-filter reset + midnight pending cleanup) is the standout reusable technique; RSI30/70 pending-grid entry itself is common

title: Different Time and Different Strategy: two-way grid then time-window martingale with balance cutloss
entry_long: 00:01-09:00 server time: open buy grid, 4 orders max, 20pip spacing, fixed 0.1 lot each, no SL/TP; 13:00-22:00 NY session: if prior buy exists, continue buy using Martingale MM block (initial 0.1 lot) each 20pip spacing while buy-side unrealized profit < $100
entry_short: mirror of buy: 4-order sell grid 00:01-09:00, then martingale sell continuation 13:00-22:00 while sell-side profit < $100
exit: close buy side when buy profit > $100; close sell side when sell profit > $100 (separate baskets); optional Cut Loss mode (off by default) closes both sides when total loss exceeds 30% of balance
escalation_cap: 4 orders per side in first session (00:01-09:00); martingale MM block session (13:00-22:00) has no stated step cap
buildon_idea: cap the martingale session step count explicitly (e.g. max 3 doublings), add hard SL per basket, or swap MM block to linear-add lot law; flat-lot test first to confirm edge without escalation
novelty_note: combines fixed 4-order grid with a separate martingale session gated by time-of-day; unusual two-phase design but core mechanism (grid+martingale, no SL) is common

title: EMA Scalping Grid and Hedging: EMA5/12 cross opens both buy+sell, grid adds every 5 pips, lot escalates after 10 trades
entry_long: EMA5 crosses EMA12 (either direction) opens both buy 0.1 lot (TP50pip) and sell 0.1 lot (TP50pip) simultaneously; if price rises after entry, add further buy grid orders every 5 pips, fixed 0.1 lot for orders 1-10, then +0.1 lot per order for order 11+
entry_short: mirror: if price falls after entry, add sell grid orders every 5 pips, fixed 0.1 lot for orders 1-10, then +0.1 lot per order for order 11+
exit: close each side (buy basket / sell basket) when its unrealized profit > $5
escalation_cap: none stated - lot size keeps increasing +0.1/order indefinitely once trade count exceeds 10 on either side
buildon_idea: add a hard max-order cap (e.g. 20) and/or SL per basket; test flat-lot (no post-10 escalation) to see if the EMA-cross+grid edge holds without the lot ramp
novelty_note: opens both buy and sell on every cross (straddle+grid hybrid); common grid mechanism but simultaneous dual-direction entry is a slightly different twist

title: Kashiwade (ZigZag Over/Under) Pattern Concept: pending orders at ZigZag swing points
entry_long: ZigZag high[0] > ZigZag high[1] AND ZigZag low[0] < ZigZag low[1] -> place buy-limit pending order 10 pips above ZigZag low[1]; cancel opposite pending sell order
entry_short: mirror: ZigZag low[0] < ZigZag low[1] AND ZigZag high[0] > ZigZag high[1] -> place sell pending order 10 pips below ZigZag high[1]; cancel opposite pending buy order
exit: SL40pip/TP80pip on buy pending order; SL40pip/TP50pip on sell pending order (as stated by narrator, values differ side to side)
escalation_cap: n/a
buildon_idea: single fixed-lot pending-order concept, no grid/martingale to build on directly; extend by adding trailing stop or ATR-based SL/TP instead of fixed pips, and test on multiple pairs/TFs
novelty_note: beginner concept version - narrator explicitly says strategy edge not yet optimized (v1, just teaching entry mechanics); low as-is edge, low novelty mechanism

title: Grid Trading Strategy and Modify TP: two-way fixed grid switches spacing/TP-merge after N orders
entry_long: no prior buy/sell exists: open first buy+sell 0.1 lot together - continues adding buy grid orders spaced GridDistance1=15pip (fixed 0.1 lot, TP15pip each) while order count<20; once order count>=20, spacing switches to GridDistance2=20pip, lot becomes lastLot+L_Plus (default L_Plus=0 so stays fixed) per new order, and TP of the first 20 orders is all modified/merged to the position of order 1
entry_short: mirror of buy side with same 20-order threshold, GridDistance1/2, and TP-merge-to-order-1 logic
exit: once order count>=20 (mtpOrder), close whole basket when unrealized profit > $20 (close_Money); orders 1-20 also individually TP15pip until the merge triggers
escalation_cap: orders 1-20 behavior changes at order 20/mtpOrder threshold but grid continues adding orders indefinitely beyond that with no stated hard cap
buildon_idea: add a hard cap on total orders after the 20-order threshold, add SL per basket, and test with L_Plus=0 (flat lot) vs enabled to isolate whether the TP-merge trick itself adds edge
novelty_note: the TP-merge-to-first-order trick (moving TP of the first N legs to a common point) is a distinctive technique worth cataloguing even if the base grid is common

title: TOB Trading Strategy Revise 1: support/resistance breakout+retest filtered by RSI and candle-body confirmation, with capped martingale-grid recovery
entry_long: price breaks below the 30-candle support line (tracked via BreakOut_S flag), then within 10 candles closes back above the support line (retest/reclaim), AND candle[2] is bearish with candle[1] bullish and body[1]>body[2] (reversal confirmation), AND RSI(7) < 30 at that candle -> open buy 0.01 lot, no SL/TP
entry_short: mirror: price breaks above resistance, retests back below within 10 candles, candle[2] bullish/candle[1] bearish with body[1]>body[2], RSI(7)>70 -> open sell 0.01 lot, no SL/TP
exit: close whole basket (buy or sell) when unrealized profit > $5; if instead price moves against the position, add recovery grid orders every 100pip (Grid Distance), lot either fixed 0.01 or +0.01/order (L_Plus_Mode toggle), capped at 30 orders max; additionally a 30%-of-balance Cut Loss mode is enabled by default and closes both sides if drawdown exceeds 30%
escalation_cap: capped at 30 orders (Max Order); lot escalation via L_Plus toggle (+0.01/order) or fixed 0.01/order
buildon_idea: already capped at 30 orders with a 30% balance cutloss; test flat-lot (L_Plus off) vs escalating, and try tightening the 100pip recovery grid distance for pairs other than gold
novelty_note: the multi-layer confirmation (breakout+retest window+candle pattern+RSI extreme) is a comparatively sophisticated entry filter stack; author reports it substantially reduced DD vs the v1 base version (EX039_teFlEzADn8A) - worth flagging as a signal-quality improvement pattern

title: TOB Trading Strategy (base v1): support/resistance breakout+retest reversal entry with capped martingale-grid recovery
entry_long: price breaks below the drawn support line (BreakOut_S flag set), then within 10 candles closes back above the support line -> open buy 0.01 lot, no SL/TP; support/resistance lines auto-drawn from 30-candle lookback and deleted once a trade opens
entry_short: mirror: price breaks above resistance, then within 10 candles closes back below it -> open sell 0.01 lot, no SL/TP
exit: close basket when unrealized profit > $5; if price moves against the position, add recovery grid orders every 10pip (Grid Distance), lot either fixed 0.01 or +0.01/order (L_Plus_Mode toggle), capped at 30 orders; 30%-of-balance Cut Loss mode enabled by default closes both sides on excess drawdown
escalation_cap: capped at 30 orders (Max Order)
buildon_idea: already capped at 30 orders + 30% cutloss; this is the base version the author later improved with RSI+candle filters (see EX039 Revise1) - worth testing the filtered version's edge on more symbols since even the unfiltered base tested profitable on both EURUSD and XAUUSD
novelty_note: simple breakout-then-retest reversal logic; common concept but the auto-drawn/auto-deleted support-resistance line mechanism plus 10-candle breakout-expiry window is a clean reusable building block

title: Limit Loss per Day: Bollinger Band mean-reversion entry with per-trade martingale and daily consecutive-loss cutoff
entry_long: no open buy/sell exists AND consecutive-loss counter < 2: candle[1] closes crossing below Bollinger lower band -> open buy using Martingale money-management (initial 0.1 lot, multiply-on-loss x2), SL20pip/TP30pip, max 1 entry per candle
entry_short: mirror: candle[1] crosses above Bollinger upper band AND consecutive-loss counter < 2 -> open sell via same Martingale MM block (x2 on loss), SL20pip/TP30pip
exit: each trade closes at its own SL(20pip)/TP(30pip); a consecutive-loss counter increments on every SL-close and resets to 0 on every TP-close; once it reaches 2, no new trades are opened until a daily reset at 00:00-00:01 server time
escalation_cap: no stated cap on the multiply-on-loss doubling sequence itself (only the daily consecutive-loss counter of 2 stops NEW trade cycles, not mid-sequence doubling)
buildon_idea: add an explicit cap on martingale doubling steps (e.g. max 3-4), and/or replace multiply-on-loss with linear-add lot law; the daily consecutive-loss-limit mechanism itself is reusable as a portfolio-level circuit breaker regardless of entry signal
novelty_note: the daily consecutive-loss-limit circuit-breaker (paired with an earlier daily-order-limit example) is a distinct risk-management building block separate from the entry signal - worth cataloguing on its own

title: RSI Concept: RSI extreme triggers uncapped linear-add grid, closed on basket profit target
entry_long: RSI(candle[1]) < 25 -> open buy 0.1 lot (first order, no SL/TP); while RSI stays <25 and price moves 15pip+ away from the last buy, add further buy orders with lot = lastLot+0.1 (linear-add), no cap on order count
entry_short: mirror: RSI(candle[1]) > 75 -> open sell 0.1 lot first order, then add sell orders every 15pip with lot = lastLot+0.1 while RSI stays >75, no cap on order count
exit: close entire basket (buy or sell) when unrealized profit > $100
escalation_cap: none - no stated maximum order count or lot size
buildon_idea: add a hard order-count/lot cap and a basket SL; author's own backtest shows Max DD 76% at 1000 USD start - flat-lot test first before any escalation to see if the RSI-extreme entry itself has edge without the linear-add lot ramp
novelty_note: simple RSI overbought/oversold grid; common mechanism. Author reports extreme profit (600%+) but with correspondingly extreme 76% DD - classic red flag for an uncapped escalating lot law, not a real edge signal

title: Forex News Trading v1: weekday/time-windowed momentum-breakout entries around scheduled news releases
entry_long: current server weekday+time is within a user-configured news window (per-weekday enable flag + two start-times per day, each active for 1 minute) AND price rises 5pip within 4 seconds (Time Bomb Up) AND total open buy/sell count <=15 -> open buy 0.1 lot, SL15pip/TP30pip, with 10pip grid-spacing add-on logic available
entry_short: mirror: within news window AND price falls 5pip within 4 seconds (Time Bomb Down) AND total open count<=15 -> open sell 0.1 lot, SL15pip/TP30pip
exit: each order closes via its own fixed SL15pip/TP30pip; no basket-level close logic described
escalation_cap: total open buy+sell count capped at 15 orders
buildon_idea: news windows must be manually re-entered weekly from ForexFactory (labor-intensive/stale-prone); automate by reading an economic-calendar CSV/API instead of hardcoded per-weekday constants; also test whether the 5pip/4sec velocity trigger generalizes beyond scheduled-news windows
novelty_note: distinctive weekday-keyed dual-time-window filter block stacked with a price-velocity breakout trigger (Time Bomb Up/Down) - the velocity-trigger mechanism itself is reusable outside the news-trading context

title: Three-candle trend + pullback candlestick entry with over-trade martingale
entry_long: ID4,ID3,ID2 three consecutive bullish candles each min body>=4 pips; ID1 is a pullback candle whose close stays above ID2's open (retracement, not full reversal) -> buy at ID0
entry_short: mirror: ID4,ID3,ID2 three consecutive bearish candles min body>=4 pips; ID1 pullback candle close stays below ID2's open -> sell at ID0
exit: TP 30 pips fixed, no SL; grid re-entry (add order) once price moves 40 pips (grid_distance) against the position and 3 candles reconfirm trend continuation; close all when combined profit > $10
escalation_cap: unspecified (lot_x mode toggle in EA properties, demo used lot=1 for 'over-trade')
buildon_idea: add explicit max-step cap on the martingale ladder; flat-lot mode (lot_x=false) already exists as a toggle - test that first to isolate entry edge from escalation; consider trailing stop instead of fixed 30-pip TP
novelty_note: common 3-bar trend-continuation + pullback-filter candlestick entry, used mainly to justify heavy martingale over-trading; low-moderate novelty

exit: SL 15 pips / TP 25 pips per order; manual close_buy/close_sell/close_all buttons also provided on chart

title: Trend-quality filter (New Top/Bottom-in-Trend) + EMA200 with optional EMA-cross cut-loss
entry_long: price above EMA200 AND New_Top_in_Trend block confirms quality uptrend (pass_candle_count=10, min_pip_range=50, trend_quality=8) -> buy fixed 0.1L, no SL/TP
entry_short: price below EMA200 AND New_Bottom_in_Trend confirms quality downtrend (same params) -> sell fixed 0.1L, no SL/TP
exit: grid-add every 10 pips (grid_distance) in trend direction while unrealized profit stays below target; close all per side when total profit > $50; optional EMA200-cross cut-loss mode (off by default) closes buy if candle ID2 crosses below EMA200, closes sell if crosses above
escalation_cap: none - continuous fixed-0.1L grid add every 10 pips while trend persists, no cap on count
buildon_idea: add a max grid-step cap and/or ATR-scaled grid distance; enable the EMA-cross cut-loss mode by default; all adds are already flat-lot (not martingale), a good baseline to build on directly
novelty_note: uses FX Dreema's proprietary New_Top/Bottom_in_Trend quality-scoring block (pass_candle_count, min_pip_range, trend_quality params) as an entry filter combined with a simple flat-lot grid; moderately novel filter choice

title: Trend-quality filter RV1: adds Follow-Trend grid-TP arm and Reverse-Trend martingale-grid rescue arm
entry_long: same first entry as EX048 (price>EMA200 + quality uptrend) -> buy 0.1L, no SL/TP; if price then moves favorably, Follow_Trend mode adds same-direction 0.1L orders every 15 pips with a trailing stop (10 pips, 1-pip step) activated once 2+ trades are open
entry_short: mirror of long using price<EMA200 + New_Bottom_in_Trend; Follow_Trend mode mirrors the add/trailing-stop logic
exit: if price instead moves against the first trade, Reverse_Trend mode adds recovery orders every 15 pips with lot size increasing by +0.05 per add (lot_BS+lot_plus), gated by a 2-candle bearish-then-bullish (or mirror) reversal confirmation; close all when total profit > 10 pips (close_pip); all state variables reset on close
lot_law: grid-add (Follow-Trend arm) plus martingale (+0.05 lot per step, Reverse-Trend arm)
escalation_cap: unspecified on Reverse-Trend arm - lot increases by +0.05 per add with no stated max-step cap
buildon_idea: cap the Reverse-Trend martingale ladder to a fixed number of adds; the Follow-Trend arm (flat +0.1L grid with trailing stop) is already the safer half - isolate and test it alone first as a build-on candidate
novelty_note: two-armed design: trend-following flat-lot grid harvester plus a counter-trend martingale rescue arm gated by candlestick reversal confirmation; author claims 5yr backtest +600%+ (unverified, untuned per author's own statement)

title: RSI 4-zone grid-martingale (1-30/31-50 buy, 51-69/70-100 sell) with balance-percent cut-loss
entry_long: RSI in [1,50] (OR of two Move_Within_Limit blocks: 1-30 and 31-50) -> buy fixed 0.1L, no SL/TP, once per bar
entry_short: RSI in [51,100] (OR of 51-69 and 70-100 blocks) -> sell fixed 0.1L, no SL/TP, once per bar
exit: grid-add every 10 pips (grid_distance) against the position; if RSI still in the extreme zone (1-30 for buy-add / 70-100 for sell-add) add with lot increasing by +0.1 per step; if RSI in the moderate zone (31-50 buy-add / 51-69 sell-add) add fixed 0.1L instead; close all per side when profit > $50 (close_money, author found $100 improved results to 60%/yr with lower DD); optional cut-loss at 30% of balance (on by default)
lot_law: martingale (linear +0.1L increment per add in the extreme RSI zone; flat-lot add in the moderate zone)
escalation_cap: none stated on step count
buildon_idea: cap the +0.1L-per-step ladder to N steps; the moderate-zone arm (flat 0.1L add) is already linear-add rather than martingale - isolate that arm for a safer build-on variant; the 30%-of-balance cut-loss is a reasonable portfolio-level cage worth keeping
novelty_note: RSI-zone-graded escalation (different add behavior in extreme vs moderate RSI zones) is a moderate twist on plain RSI mean-reversion + martingale; predecessor EX041 (referenced, not in this batch) claimed 600%+ in 2023 alone but was flagged 'not sustainable' by the author; this v2 claims a 5yr survival at ~250% (default) or higher when close_money is tuned to 100

title: Custom-sequence (weighted multiplier) money management with reversal candlestick entry

family: reversal-candlestick entry with custom-sequence martingale money management

title: Liquidity/Inducement trap-avoidance EA (impulse+engulfing accumulate, TP before liquidity zone)
timeframe: 5min (creator states 15min design but actually backtested on 5min)
entry_long: 3 consecutive down candles (body open>close each) = down impulse >=20 pips total body; wait for reversal signal (ID2 down, ID1 up) then open buy 0.1 lot, accumulate on each new reversal signal while price stays below dynamic TP line (10 pips before the impulse-start candle's open, i.e. before the liquidity/resistance zone)
entry_short: mirror: 3 consecutive up candles >=20 pips = up impulse, accumulate sell 0.1 lot on each reversal signal (ID2 up, ID1 down) while price stays above dynamic TP line (10 pips above impulse-start open)
exit: close all when price crosses the dynamic TP line (BTAB/STAB, set 10 pips before the liquidity zone) OR floating profit >500 USD; SL line drawn 40 pips beyond first order's open as manual cut-loss reference
escalation_cap: none stated (accumulates on every reversal signal until TP-line hit or 500 USD profit; only a visual SL line, no coded hard cap on order count)
buildon_idea: add explicit max-order cap (e.g. 5-8 adds) and convert the visual BSL/SSL lines into a coded hard stop; test on pending-limit fills instead of market entries to reduce spread cost from frequent accumulation
novelty_note: unusual concept - deliberately closes profit before reaching the liquidity/support-resistance zone to avoid violent reversal spikes; creator reports only ~10-16% return over 2023-24 on 5min EU, high order count (3000+/2yr)

title: Triple Ci: reversal candlestick + EMA250 + Stochastic confluence entry, grid-add correction

exit: basket close per side when floating profit (sum as position) > 15 pips; account-level cut-loss switch (default off) closes both sides if loss > 30% of balance, then terminate EA
escalation_cap: none on order count (only a 30%-of-balance money cut-loss circuit breaker + optional terminate); grid distance 15 pips, each add lot = previous + 0.05
buildon_idea: add a hard Max_Order cap (the creator's later examples EX057-61 all add this); backtest showed 132% return but 59% Max DD on 2019 EU 1000 USD - capping order count plus switching grid adds to pending limit orders would likely tame the drawdown
novelty_note: 3-indicator confluence (reversal candle + EMA200-ish trend filter + stochastic momentum) is a common combo; sourced from a Facebook page tip, not original

title: Advance Trading Robot #1: RSI-zone entry with dual-speed grid spacing, Max-Order capped, password/account-lock admin features
symbol: EURUSD (creator notes gold needs 10x grid distance)
entry_long: RSI in zone 1-50 -> open buy 0.1 lot fixed (no SL/TP), then grid-add corrective buys every 10 pips as price falls, with lot size scaling by RSI zone (tighter/larger add in oversold 1-30 vs wider in 31-50, though creator left both at same 10-pip spacing this session)
entry_short: RSI in zone 51-100 -> open sell 0.1 lot fixed, grid-add corrective sells every 10 pips as price rises
exit: close all (buy or sell side, whichever triggered) when floating profit as-position > 500 pips OR price crosses back through the opposite condition; explicit Max_Order=20 cap per side halts further adds; optional 30%-of-balance cut-loss
escalation_cap: 20 orders (Max_Order constant), enforced via check-trade-count block before each add
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders; try adding a hard SL, or convert grid adds to pending buy/sell-limit orders to capture maker-side fills instead of paying spread on every market add; explore splitting the RSI zones into distinct grid spacings as the creator planned but didn't implement
novelty_note: standard RSI-zone grid/martingale template that recurs across this creator's 'Advance Trading Robot' series; also demonstrates chart button + logo + backtest-speed toggling utility blocks (admin/tooling, not part of the trading edge)

title: Advance Trading Robot #2: RSI + doji entry, selectable Martingale-SL/TP mode vs Grid-fixed-lot mode, password + account-ID lock
indicators: doji detection (lower wick > body*? and lower wick/2 > upper wick, or mirror for upper wick)
entry_long: RSI(ID1) < 30 (oversold) AND doji-like candle (lower wick half > upper wick, lower wick > body) -> if switch=Martingale mode: buy with built-in Martingale money-management lot sizing, SL 30 pips/TP 60 pips; if switch=Grid mode: buy fixed 0.1 lot, no SL/TP, then grid-add every 15 pips as price falls (capped by Max_Order=20 per side in grid mode)
entry_short: mirror: RSI(ID1) > 70 AND doji (upper wick half > lower wick, upper wick > body) -> Martingale mode sell SL30/TP60, or Grid mode fixed 0.1 lot sell with 15-pip grid adds capped at 20 orders
exit: basket close per mode when floating profit (as-position) > 50 USD; 30%-of-balance cut-loss closes both sides; EA also terminates if account ID/password mismatch
escalation_cap: Grid mode: 20 orders (Max_Order); Martingale mode: relies on fxDreema's built-in Martingale block with per-order SL/TP 30/60 pips but no stated lot-multiplier cap
buildon_idea: Grid mode is already order-capped and buildable; for the Martingale mode, add an explicit max-lot or max-consecutive-loss cap on the built-in Martingale block before treating it as anything but a smoke test; the account-ID/password lock is vendor-protection boilerplate, not part of the edge
novelty_note: same RSI-zone family as EX057 but swaps the reversal trigger for a doji filter and offers a toggle between two money-management styles in one EA

title: Advance Trading Robot #3: MACD Divergence (classic+hidden) entry, grid-add capped at 15 orders with single hedge-lot escape
indicators: MACD Divergence (classic and hidden, both bullish/bearish variants) via fxDreema various-signal block
entry_long: Classic-divergence group: MACD Divergence = bullish -> buy 0.01 lot fixed, grid-add every 10 pips as price falls (capped 15 orders/group); if the 15th order is hit, open one hedge sell of 0.15 lot (once, via counter-pass-1 gate). Hidden-divergence group runs the same logic in parallel as an independent group (group ID 2) with entries mirrored (bullish hidden -> sell, per creator's note)
entry_short: Classic group: MACD Divergence = bearish -> sell 0.01 lot, grid-add every 10 pips as price rises, capped 15 orders, hedge buy 0.15 lot once at cap. Hidden group mirrors classic with buy/sell swapped
exit: per-group basket close when floating profit > 5 USD (close_profit); counters reset after each close to allow the hedge order again next cycle
escalation_cap: 15 orders per group (Max_Order), with a single capped hedge order (0.15 lot) as an escape valve at the cap - this is a genuinely capped design
buildon_idea: already capped and using a bounded hedge escape - good build-on candidate; a real user reportedly ran the earlier version (EX10) live for 2 months with >100% return at 13-15 orders/cycle. Worth expanding symbol/TF coverage and testing pending-limit fills for the grid adds to cut spread cost
novelty_note: first example in this batch combining classic+hidden MACD divergence as two independently-tracked trade groups within one EA (group-ID pattern reused across order/formula/counter blocks)

title: Engulfing Breakout Trading Strategy: auto support/resistance line + break-and-retest engulfing entry, grid-add capped
indicators: auto support/resistance lines (highest/lowest of last 30 candles)
entry_long: price previously broke down through the auto support line, then retraces back up through it forming a bullish engulfing (ID2 bearish, ID1 bullish, ID1 body > ID2 body) -> buy 0.01 lot fixed (or lot+0.05 per add if lot_plus_mode enabled, default off), grid-add every 10 pips capped at 10 orders (Max_Order); support/resistance lines auto-regenerate if price doesn't retrace within 10 candles of the break
entry_short: mirror: price broke up through resistance then retraces down through it forming bearish engulfing -> sell 0.01 lot, same grid-add/cap logic
exit: basket close (buy+sell combined) when floating profit > 5 USD; optional 30%-of-balance cut-loss then terminate EA
escalation_cap: 10 orders (Max_Order)
buildon_idea: already capped; the auto S/R line logic (rolling 30-bar high/low with 10-bar staleness reset) is a reusable building block worth extracting into EDGE_CATALOG independent of this EA's grid/engulfing entry; test on higher TF where 30-bar S/R is more meaningful
novelty_note: built on top of the creator's earlier example #39; the auto-regenerating S/R line with break-then-retest-engulfing entry is a moderately distinct mechanism worth cataloging separately from the generic grid/engulfing template

title: Advance Trading Robot #4: Awesome Oscillator momentum-exhaustion + zero-line entry, grid-add capped at 30
entry_long: candle ID1 bullish (body>=2pips) AND Awesome Oscillator forms a momentum-exhaustion+reversal shape: ID1>ID2, ID3>ID2, ID4>ID3 (all above zero line) -> buy 0.1 lot fixed, grid-add every 10 pips (lot+0.05 optional) capped at 30 orders per side
entry_short: mirror below zero line: ID1 bearish, AO ID1<ID2<ID3<ID4 (all below zero, i.e. increasingly negative reversing toward less negative) -> sell 0.1 lot, same grid-add/cap logic
exit: basket close per pass when floating profit (as-position) > 5 pips (close_pip constant); no cut-loss/terminate logic shown in this example
escalation_cap: 30 orders (Max_Order)
buildon_idea: already capped; creator's own A/B test (separating buy-first/sell-first tracking) showed capping/splitting logic barely changes results (1749->1800 orders, similar profit) - so the AO entry signal itself, not the grid mechanics, is the lever to test further; try alternate exit (partial TP) since 5-pip close is very tight vs 76% Max DD reported over 5yr EU 1H backtest
novelty_note: an evolution of the creator's earlier basic AO example (EX17); demonstrated 76% Max DD over 5yr/EU 1H at 10,000 USD - high DD despite the order cap, worth flagging for the DD lever specifically

title: Advance Trading Robot #5 (gold parameter tuning session): EMA(3/8) cross entry with doubling-martingale grid-add, tuned for XAUUSD
entry_long: EMA3 crosses above EMA8 AND price within 5000 points of EMA -> buy 0.01 lot; if price falls further, grid-add every 5000-point (grid_distance) interval with each add lot = 2x previous (doubling martingale)
entry_short: mirror: EMA3 crosses below EMA8 within 5000-point distance -> sell 0.01 lot, grid-add doubling lot every 5000 points as price rises
exit: basket close both sides when floating profit > 30 USD (close_money); circuit-breaker closes everything if either side's order count exceeds 400 (Cut_loss_Order), no per-order SL/TP stated
escalation_cap: 400 orders per side (Cut_loss_Order) is the only stated cap - lot itself doubles uncapped until that order-count ceiling, no max-lot value given
buildon_idea: this is presented as a parameter-tuning session (community-sourced XAUUSD params: >900% return, 14,500+ orders, 37% Max DD over 2019-2023) rather than a new mechanism - before trusting it, cap the martingale multiplier itself (not just order count) since doubling lot for up to 400 orders is an extreme fat-tail risk; flat-lot test the EMA(3/8) cross entry alone to see if it has edge without the escalation
novelty_note: same base EA as EX061/earlier examples, re-tuned for gold with much wider grid distance (5000 points) and explicit doubling martingale; the video is essentially a parameter-sharing/tuning demo, not new mechanism content - flagged as thin on original teaching content

title: Grid hedge two-way profit v2: EMA3/8 cross + distance filter, fixed-lot grid add, count-based cut-loss
entry_long: no open buy/sell yet; EMA fast(3) crosses above EMA slow(8) at candle ID1, and current price within 15 pips below EMA fast -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: EMA fast crosses below EMA slow at ID1, price within 15 pips of EMA fast -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: grid-add correction orders (fixed 0.1 lot, spacing=GridDistance*2=30pips) both directions; close-all when combined unrealized profit of the losing-side basket >= 5 pips OR when either side's order count >= CutLossOrder(30) -> force close both sides
escalation_cap: none (fixed 0.1 lot per node, capped by order-count cut-loss at 30 orders/side)
buildon_idea: already order-count capped at 30/side; try widening grid spacing or tightening cut-loss count, and test with real SL as backstop since current risk control relies only on trade-count cutoff
novelty_note: revision of example 30 (grid hedging two-way profit) with EMA cross entry filter added; count-based (not equity-based) cut-loss is the distinctive piece

title: RSI(14) 30/70 entry, dual-mode: snowball trend-follow grid + martingale correction grid
entry_long: no prior buy/sell; RSI(14) at candle ID1 crosses above 30 -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: RSI(14) at candle ID1 crosses below 70 -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: two modes after first order: (1) snowball/follow-trend mode activates if price beyond 30pip grid step from prior same-side order in favorable direction, adds 0.1 lot fixed each 30pips, then group trailing-stop 15pips/step1 once >=2 orders open; (2) martingale mode activates if price moves 50pips against position AND RSI shows reversal confirmation (cross back through 30/70), adds lot=prevLot*2 (MLX=2) each 50pip+reversal step, closes all when combined profit >= $50
escalation_cap: none (no volume cap stated for martingale doubling; only stops via $50 profit-target close)
buildon_idea: add a Volume Upper Limit / max-doubling-step cap to the martingale leg (later examples in this series add exactly this fix); flat-lot test the martingale leg with escalation disabled to check if RSI reversal entry alone has edge
novelty_note: first EA in this series to combine a trend-following grid (snowball) with a separate martingale correction grid gated by RSI reversal confirmation, auto-switching between the two via mode flags

title: EX064 revise1: 3-candle pattern + EMA3/8 filter, forward/reverse-trend grid, martingale capped at 1 lot via Volume Upper Limit
entry_long: no open trade; 3 consecutive bullish candles (ID1-3, open<close) + EMA fast(3)>EMA slow(8) + price within 200 pips of EMA fast -> buy 0.01 lot
entry_short: mirror: 3 consecutive bearish candles + EMA fast<EMA slow + distance filter -> sell 0.01 lot
exit: ForwardTrend mode: price beyond 50pip grid from prior order in favorable direction -> add 0.01 lot fixed, close all at $5 profit; ReverseTrend mode: price 100pips against position -> add lot=prevLot*MLX(2), each add capped by Volume Upper Limit=1.0 lot, close all at $5 profit
escalation_cap: 1.0 lot (Volume Upper Limit on the buy/sell blocks)
buildon_idea: already capped at 1 lot; flat-lot test the ForwardTrend grid alone (no martingale) since it produced the bulk of the reported ~96% annual return in one 2024 sample; consider linear-add instead of doubling for the reverse leg to reduce blowup speed before the 1-lot cap is hit
novelty_note: revised version of the base EX064 that adds the Volume Upper Limit safety cap missing from the original (see EX064/hD_0LRbHUGg) plus a fast/slow EMA trend filter on top of the 3-candle pattern

title: Advance Trading Robot #7: 3-white-soldiers/3-black-crows entry, forward/reverse-trend grid, uncapped martingale doubling
entry_long: no open buy/sell; 3 consecutive bullish candles (ID1-3, min body 2 pips, T White Soldier pattern) -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: 3 consecutive bearish candles (T Black Crow) -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: ForwardTrend mode: price beyond SGridDistance(15pips) in favorable direction -> add 0.1 lot fixed, group trailing-stop(15pip/step1) once >=2 orders; ReverseTrend mode: price 50pips against position AND bullish/bearish engulfing reversal confirm -> add lot=prevLot*MLX(2) (fix-volume using computed MLBS, so effectively martingale doubling, also fires an intermediate 'yellow output' fixed-volume add at current MLBS before the 50pip threshold if reversal candles appear early), close all at $30 combined profit
escalation_cap: none stated (no Volume Upper Limit in this build; relies only on the $30 profit-close and engulfing reversal gate before adding)
buildon_idea: add an explicit lot/order cap (the sibling revision EX064/3MJMu9D8WKg already does this with Volume Upper Limit=1) before treating this as buildable; otherwise swap martingale doubling for linear-add (fixed increment) on the reverse leg
novelty_note: direct predecessor of the capped revision; introduces the reversal-candle-gated martingale add (won't add purely on distance, waits for an engulfing-style flip) which is the reusable idea even without the martingale sizing

title: EMA200 distance-filter entry, forward/reverse grid capped at 15 orders, close first-order-plus-profitable-orders basket
indicators: EMA100(EMA_Train constant, labeled ema200 in narration)
entry_long: no open trade; price below EMA_Train(100) by more than DistanceTrend(25 pips) -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: price above EMA_Train by more than a distance threshold (narrator states ~60 pips, though same DistanceTrend constant=25 is defined; treat exact sell-side distance as unspecified due to transcript inconsistency) -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: ForwardTrend: price beyond GridDistance(20pips) in favorable direction -> add 0.1 lot fixed, group trailing-stop(25pip/step1) once >=2 orders; ReverseTrend: price against position -> add 0.1 lot fixed grid (no lot escalation), capped at MaxOrder=15 total orders/side; close logic closes the oldest order plus whichever of orders #1-15 are individually profitable once their combined profit (profit_All) exceeds CloseMoney($10)
escalation_cap: 15 orders (Max Order), fixed 0.1 lot per add (no martingale)
buildon_idea: already order-capped and fixed-lot (no martingale) which is the safer end of this series; the reusable piece is the per-slot profit-tracking pattern (profit_1..profit_15) for closing only-the-profitable-plus-oldest order -- worth extracting into a generic 'basket partial close' module
novelty_note: builds on example 52's close-first-and-close-profitable-orders technique; distinctive for capping correction adds by order count rather than lot escalation, and for showing the manual per-slot profit array extraction pattern for up to 15 legs

title: Hidden-bar zone breakout (EMA200 + 2-candle pattern draws S/R line), forward/reverse grid with linear lot-add
entry_long: price closes above EMA200 and 2 consecutive bullish candles (min body 10 pips) draw a 'Zone Buy' horizontal line at candle ID2's high; when price crosses back down through that line -> buy 0.1 lot (zone line auto-deletes/redraws each new qualifying 2-candle pattern, or deletes if price drifts >80 pips away)
entry_short: mirror: price below EMA200 + 2 bearish candles draw 'Zone Sell' line at candle ID2's low; price crosses back up through it -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: ForwardTrend: price beyond GridDistance(15pips) in favorable direction -> add 0.1 lot fixed, group trailing-stop(15pip/step1) once >=2 orders; ReverseTrend: price against position + 2-candle reversal confirm -> add lot=prevLot+LPlus(0.05, linear increment) each 15pip+reversal step, close all at 10-pip combined profit
escalation_cap: none stated on number of reverse-mode adds (only the $/pip profit-close ends the sequence); lot grows by fixed +0.05 increment per add, not multiplicative
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-order cap on the ReverseTrend linear-add leg (currently unbounded); the zone-line breakout entry (auto-drawn S/R from 2-candle momentum, redrawn/deleted by distance) is a reusable standalone signal worth testing without the grid/martingale wrapper
novelty_note: distinctive entry mechanism: draws a live horizontal zone line from 2-candle momentum near EMA200 and enters only on a pullback-and-reject of that line, rather than entering directly on the pattern

title: Bollinger middle-line + 3-candle pattern entry, forward/reverse-trend grid, uncapped reverse-leg adds (lot flat by default)
entry_long: no open trade; 3 consecutive bullish candles (min body 3 pips) with candle ID1 close below Bollinger middle line -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: 3 consecutive bearish candles with ID1 close above Bollinger middle line -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: ForwardTrend: price beyond GridDistance(10pips) in favorable direction -> add 0.1 lot fixed, group trailing-stop(10pip/step3) once >=2 orders; ReverseTrend: price against position + 2-candle reversal confirm -> add lot=prevLot+LPlus(default 0, so effectively fixed 0.1 unless user sets LPlus>0) each 15pip(wider grid than forward leg, per narrator's own suggestion)+reversal step, close all at 10-pip combined profit
escalation_cap: none stated (no max-order limit on the reverse-leg grid; LPlus defaults to 0 so lot size stays flat unless configured)
buildon_idea: add an explicit order-count cap to the ReverseTrend leg (this build has none); the wider-grid-for-reverse-than-forward design choice the narrator calls out is a reusable tuning idea for the other EAs in this series that use equal spacing both ways
novelty_note: same forward/reverse grid skeleton as the rest of the series but swaps the entry signal to Bollinger middle-line position + 3-candle pattern; narrator explicitly recommends asymmetric grid spacing (tighter for trend-follow, wider for correction) as a general improvement

title: Fibonacci auto-line + triple-EMA filter grid EA (Advance Robot #11)
entry_long: EMA5>EMA100 and EMA5 crosses below EMA12 (candle_id1) draws fib_buy retracement line from 90-candle high/low; when price crosses up any fib level (0,23.6,38.2,50,61.8,78.6,100) open buy 0.1 lot, delete fib_buy line after entry
entry_short: mirror: EMA5<EMA100 and EMA5 crosses above EMA12 draws fib_sell line; price crosses down any fib_sell level -> open sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>5 pips; trailing stop 15/step5 once trade count>=2 (follow-mode only, disabled in reverse-mode); follow-mode adds every 2x grid_distance(30 pip) in trend direction; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with optional L_Plus lot increment (default 0)
escalation_cap: none
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap (none present); flat-lot test (L_Plus=0, already default) to isolate fib+EMA entry edge before judging; author's own 5yr in-sample backtest only, needs OOS
novelty_note: auto-drawn Fibonacci retracement (90-candle lookback) gated by triple-EMA cross as entry trigger; fib-level entry idea is somewhat novel vs plain EMA-cross EAs in this catalog

title: Triple-EMA simultaneous-cross candlestick EA (Advance Robot #12)
symbol: EURUSD (also demoed on XAUUSD with adjusted params)
entry_long: candle_id1 and candle_id2 bullish candles, candle_id1 open above EMA5; candle_id2 close crosses above EMA5, EMA8 and EMA12 simultaneously -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: candle_id1/2 bearish, candle_id1 open below EMA5; candle_id2 close crosses below EMA5, EMA8, EMA12 simultaneously -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>10 USD (close_Money); trailing stop 15/step5 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode); follow-mode grid every 2x(20 pip)=40 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with optional L_Plus increment
escalation_cap: none
buildon_idea: add max-order/lot cap; author gives separate XAUUSD parameter set (candle_pip 50, close_Money 300, grid/reverse distance 400, trailing 300/30, L_Plus 0.01) worth testing as a second home; flat-lot verification needed before trusting 200%+/500%+ in-sample gains
novelty_note: requires all 3 EMAs crossed by the same candle close - stricter than typical dual-EMA cross; low-to-moderate novelty

title: Williams %R + EMA200 trend-filter grid EA (Advance Robot #13)
entry_long: candle_id1 close above EMA200 and Williams %R (candle_id1) crosses above -80 (exiting oversold) -> buy 0.1 lot
entry_short: candle_id1 close below EMA200 and Williams %R (candle_id1) crosses below -20 (exiting overbought) -> sell 0.1 lot
exit: close all when combined profit>10 pips; trailing stop 10/step1 after trade count>=2 (follow-mode); follow-mode grid every 2x(15 pip)=30 pip; reverse-mode adds on opposite-direction engulfing signal with L_Plus=0.05 lot increment per add
